== Prayer cues: phases 1 and 3 ==
'''Two different attacks. Read the whole cue.'''

=== Three colours → three prayers ===
The '''base tank''' watches the three orbs and changes prayer for each hit. The short spoken cue tells you the same order.

{{PvME prayer sequence|call=Pathetic|first=melee|second=ranged|third=magic|who=Base tank}}
{{PvME prayer sequence|call=Weak|first=ranged|second=magic|third=melee|who=Base tank}}
{{PvME prayer sequence|call=Grovel|first=magic|second=melee|third=ranged|who=Base tank}}

<p class="am-picture-caption">Tri-colour Attack / Triple Tap. Sword = melee; bow = ranged; wand = magic. Each symbol also has a written label. This attack targets the base tank.</p>

=== One sky colour → the same prayer three times ===
'''Everyone''' handles Triple Strike / Empowered Eruption. Keep the matching prayer on for all three hits.

{{PvME prayer sequence|call=All strength withers|first=melee|second=melee|third=melee|who=Everyone · red sky}}
{{PvME prayer sequence|call=I will not suffer this|first=ranged|second=ranged|third=ranged|who=Everyone · green sky}}
{{PvME prayer sequence|call=Your soul is WEAK|first=magic|second=magic|third=magic|who=Everyone · blue sky}}

<div class="am-picture-grid">
{{PvME picture card
|icon=scarab
|title=Scarabs: stun first
|cue=“Tear them apart” + charging scarabs.
|action=Stun them, then finish any that survive.
|detail=They are damage-immune until stunned. Standing on a spawn prevents it appearing. Use the team’s planned Barricade timing if covering an explosion.
}}

{{PvME picture card
|icon=people
|title=“Bend the knee”: the big share
|cue=Soul Crush targets the base.
|action=Use the agreed defensive or damage-share plan.
|detail=The base can plan Immortality after Tri-colour Attack; it must still be available. Alternatively, designated DPS provoke and share within 3×3 using Reflect + Powerburst of vitality. It pierces defensives: an unplanned pile is dangerous.
}}

{{PvME picture card
|icon=shield
|title=Normal attacks still matter
|cue=Left hand / green ball = magic. Right hand slash = melee.
|action=Base: protect against the incoming style.
|detail=Melee can splash nearby players and ricochet ranged hits within 10 tiles of the base. Rapid Swipes need attention; follow the full guide’s defensive plan.
}}

{{PvME picture card
|icon=run
|title=Floor marks: move
|cue=An attack marks or sweeps the floor.
|action=Step into a safe, unmarked area.
|detail=Shockwaves can disable defensives for 6 seconds. Moving early is safer than relying on a last-second defensive.
}}
</div>

== Rescue: phases 2 and 4 ==
'''Amascut is immune. Free both gods to continue.''' At 100%, the destruction timer is '''200 seconds'''.

{{PvME picture flow
|type=chains
|label=Rescue a god, then carry its fragment
|icon1=gate
|one=Kill the gatekeeper → enter
|icon2=chain
|two=Kill chainwarden + a chain
|icon3=statue
|three=Outside: click the GOLD statue
|icon4=fragment
|four=Carry fragment to OPPOSITE statue
|caption=Repeat chain → gold-statue cleanse three times for each room. A green statue is too early and hurts the team. Bring both fragments across to restore their statues; damage Amascut when vulnerable.
}}

<div class="am-picture-grid">
{{PvME picture card
|icon=people
|title=Inside and outside must talk
|cue=A chain reaches 0 LP; its statue turns golden.
|action=Outside cleanses it promptly. Inside moves to the next chain.
|detail=Chains can return if the cleanse is missed. In phase 2, the chains role handles two chains and carries the fragment; the statues role handles one. In phase 4 both can stay inside while the base cleanses.
}}

{{PvME picture card
|icon=fragment
|title=Carrying a fragment
|cue=You are holding Tumeken’s fragment.
|action=Run to the statue opposite your portal.
|detail=Surge, Escape and Dive are disabled while carrying it; Barge still works.
}}

{{PvME picture card
|icon=scarab
|title=Phase 4: green shields
|cue=Gatekeepers, chainwardens or chains are shielded.
|action=Kill an explosive scarab → grab it → click the shielded target.
|detail=These scarabs have 5,000 LP and are throwable after death. The body expires; use it promptly. Plan Barricade for remaining scarabs exploding at the start of phase 5.
}}

{{PvME picture card
|icon=warning
|title=Crocodile = basic attacks
|cue=A Modest crocodile demon is attacking.
|action=Protect against it; use basics and conjures.
|detail=Thresholds, ultimates and many enhanced attacks reflect. Be careful with bouncing Death Skulls. Their charged magic hit drains adrenaline.
}}

{{PvME picture card
|icon=people
|title=Burden: know the pass
|cue=Apmeken’s Burden is bleeding a player.
|action=Use the team’s pass plan when needed.
|detail=A player who has never had it can receive it by standing within one tile at a damage tick. The basic guide says it does not reach its instant-kill limit below 2000%; higher-enrage behaviour is different.
}}

{{PvME picture card
|icon=run
|title=Watch the floor between jobs
|cue=Soulfire waves or shockwaves approach.
|action=Move clear while keeping your assigned job.
|detail=Magic prayer reduces Soulfire damage. Defensive options and wave positioning are in the full guide; the pattern, rather than a fixed safe square, determines where to go.
}}
</div>

== Protect the light: phase 5 ==
'''There is no phase timer.''' Build the light bridge, protect the fragments, then protect Tumeken.

{{PvME picture flow
|type=flow
|label=Charge the fragments of Tumeken
|icon1=statue
|one=Stand in the statue’s light
|icon2=people
|two=Form the bridge to a fragment
|icon3=light
|three=Charge it; ideally prepare two
|icon4=target
|four=Click Tumeken to reform him
|caption=Use your team’s assigned charge positions. Far fragments belong to Apmeken/Crondis; near fragments belong to Het/Scabaras. Keep the soul obelisks below full charge by dealing damage; a damage-over-time ability helps.
}}

<div class="am-picture-grid">
{{PvME picture card
|icon=shield
|title=While charging: swap interceptors
|cue=“Your light will be snuffed out…” — arrows target the altars.
|action=The two interceptors take turns blocking them.
|detail=After blocking one, you have Interceptor: another hit kills you. Your partner intercepting clears it. Use the agreed defensive; this is a different job from the named strike below.
}}

{{PvME picture card
|icon=dog
|title=Stop the dogs
|cue=Lightstealer salawa akhs approach a fragment or Tumeken.
|action=Bind, intercept or kill them before they reach the light.
|detail=They keep their drain progress when switching targets. Once fragments are recalled, clearing the dogs is urgent.
}}

{{PvME picture card
|icon=target
|title=While reforming: YOUR name
|cue=Tumeken says “<name>, shield us from her shadow…”; your sky turns gold.
|action=Be the FIRST player in the line from Amascut to Tumeken.
|detail=Other players must leave the front position to the named player. Four charged strikes occur, one per jump; keep damaging Amascut when available.
}}

{{PvME picture card
|icon=warning
|title=Keep the two intercept jobs separate
|cue=A charging altar bolt and a named reforming strike have different cues.
|action=For altar bolts: alternate. For reforming strikes: follow the named call.
|detail=Losing Tumeken’s progress or health can wipe the team. Read the cue before moving.
}}
</div>

{{PvME picture flow
|type=intercept
|label=The named player stands first in the attack line
|icon1=boss
|one=AMASCUT
|icon2=target
|two=YOU · named player
|icon3=light
|three=TUMEKEN
|icon4=check
|four=Team protected
|caption=Schematic attack line. The called player must be hit first; standing somewhere along the line behind another player does not intercept it correctly.
}}

== Climb and regroup: phase 6 ==
'''One climber above. The team works below.'''

{{PvME picture flow
|type=climb
|label=Four platform enemies, then claim the light
|icon1=platform
|one=Kill platform enemy 1
|icon2=platform
|two=Kill platform enemy 2
|icon3=platform
|three=Kill platform enemy 3
|icon4=platform
|four=Kill platform enemy 4 → click light
|caption=The climber has 30 seconds; each enemy has 15,000 LP. Call your glowing glyph. A teammate standing on that matching ground glyph pauses the collapse timer until the next platform.
}}

<div class="am-picture-grid">
{{PvME picture card
|icon=platform
|title=Climber: bring the burst
|cue=The Path of Tumeken glows on the west or east side.
|action=Enter, kill all four enemies, then click Tumeken’s light.
|detail=Prepare the starting adrenaline/stacks and your full climber rotation from the main guide. Timing out can kill the climber and unleash the stored shield damage.
}}

{{PvME picture card
|icon=people
|title=Ground team: help the climb
|cue=Your climber calls a glyph; shadow tears appear.
|action=Match the glyph, keep the central shadow low and absorb tears.
|detail=The central shadow cannot be killed. Avoid Invoke Death on it: respawning it adds health. Tears heal the shadow if left alone.
}}

{{PvME picture card
|icon=shield
|title=Clones: stack behind Amascut
|cue=Clones spawn after the climber claims the light.
|action=Group up behind Amascut and kill the clones together.
|detail=Protect Magic for the initial dash, then Melee when they reach you. Use your planned area damage.
}}

{{PvME picture card
|icon=light
|title=Bomb warning: find the glow
|cue=Clones survived long enough to turn their targets into bombs.
|action=Finish the clones; otherwise gather near the Enlightened climber.
|detail=The golden aura reduces most bomb damage. A bomb outside the aura can still hit people inside it. After the clones die, burst Amascut during the short damage window.
}}
</div>

{{PvME picture flow
|type=clones
|label=Prayer changes as the clones close the distance
|icon1=people
|one=Stack behind boss
|icon2=magic
|two=Initial dash: MAGIC
|icon3=melee
|three=Up close: MELEE
|icon4=check
|four=AoE clones → burst boss
|caption=The climber has Enlightened, shown as a golden aura. Keep the team together; then use the damage window to reduce the shield and real health before phase 7.
}}

== Finish: phase 7 ==
'''Listen for the god’s name → pull Amascut to that statue.''' Your team assigns quadrants; the base fills gaps.

{{PvME arena picture
|type=statues
|label=Phase 7 statue positions with north at the top
|nw=Apmeken · NW
|ne=Scabaras · NE
|center=Tumeken
|sw=Het · SW
|se=Crondis · SE
|caption=Keep north at the top when reading this schematic. Tumeken’s bolt of light also points to the correct statue; the statues can be examined.
}}

{| class="wikitable am-picture-calls"
! scope="col" | Hear this name
! scope="col" | Go here
! scope="col" | Prepare for the follow-up
|-
| '''Apmeken''' — “I am sorry, Apmeken.” || North-west || Burden; use the pass plan if needed.
|-
| '''Scabaras''' — “Scabaras…” || North-east || Throw '''three''' dead explosive scarabs at Amascut to remove her shield.
|-
| '''Het''' — “Forgive me, Het.” || South-west || Damage taken heals her; keep dodging and focus the kill.
|-
| '''Crondis''' — “Crondis… It should have never come to this.” || South-east || Crocodiles; basic attacks/conjures if you need to kill them. Avoid bouncing reflected attacks.
|}

{{PvME picture flow
|type=flow
|label=Complete the statue pull, then use the damage window
|icon1=eye
|one=Hear the god’s NAME
|icon2=statue
|two=Provoke from its statue
|icon3=run
|three=Move aside / block follow-up
|icon4=boss
|four=Burst during Light Within
|caption=The statue pull must happen within roughly 3 global cooldowns. After the correct provoke, step away or use Resonance / Disruption Shield for the heavy follow-up. A successful interception grants a 30-second damage window. Keep dodging floor telegraphs and matching the sky-colour prayer.
}}

<div class="am-picture-warning">'''If the pull fails:''' protect Tumeken, collect shadow tears and prepare for Soul Crush on the base. If Tumeken dies, the team wipes. Use the full guide’s recovery plan.</div>
